sentences.en: From this you can conclude that feminism is still necessary.
sentences.zh: 由此可见，女权主义仍然有必要。

sentences.en: And what about feminism? What is your opinion on this?
sentences.zh: 至于女权主义呢？你对此有什么看法？

sentences.en: Who are you to say that feminism isn’t about equality?
sentences.zh: 你怎么能说女权主义不是关于平等的？
